scope: Review of the uncommitted AthenaK PIC/MHD/restart/mesh implementation batch. This record supports Q-042 architecture and style review but does not qualify Frontier GPU, MPI-runtime, scientific-reproduction, or restart-failure-matrix claims.

reviewed_surfaces.notes: Runtime controls are explicit and startup-validated; hot loops remain Kokkos kernels; adaptive delta-f is inserted through the existing TaskList; deposited moments and diagnostics retain particle-module ownership.

Wave damping and expanding-box maps are staged through existing MHD task dependencies. CT current injection remains in MHD::EFieldSrc and paper-mode isolation is guarded by the particle runtime model.

Particle-aware AMR cost is opt-in with a zero-cost default, feeds the existing Mesh::LoadBalance interface, and runs on the host AMR control path. Particle retained state is refreshed through Particles::UpdateAfterAMR.

Restart schema state remains integrated through the existing writer, loader, and IOWrapper surfaces. Particle diagnostics extend existing VTK and tracking outputs. restart_utils isolates atomic promotion and completion-marker durability helpers.
Restart load and physical-state initialization remain in established problem-generator paths with explicit mode guards.

corrections_applied_during_review.change: Removed inherited but unused headeroffset and ppart declarations exposed by touched-file warning review.
Hoisted expanding-box timestep scale factors out of the per-particle Boris kernel and bypassed their evaluation when expanding-box mode is disabled.
Replaced adaptive-cadence long long state with std::int64_t to satisfy fixed-width integer lint policy.
Added the direct vector include required by the mesh header and removed inherited whitespace debt from touched headers.

scoped_reliability_extension.reason: Atomic checkpoint promotion and durable completion metadata require file fsync, directory fsync, and rename operations not represented by the previous IOWrapper API.
scoped_reliability_extension.scope_limit: The helper is isolated under outputs and called by the existing restart publication path. Frontier filesystem interrupted-write and write-failure qualification remain open.

targeted_vendored_cpplint.scope: All 21 touched or newly added C++ source/header files with the repository-wide build/include_subdir convention filtered as baseline debt

repository_vendored_cpplint_baseline.method: Repaired repository wrapper invoked from both the repository root and /tmp. Both caller-directory-independent invocations used the vendored tst/scripts/style/cpplint.py read-only, exited 1 with the same pre-existing style baseline, and preserved its SHA-256 hash 0c9f128f029c91c3eda8b033a4d879e2f5c904b1607b0af5fb89636dc716a603.

residual_risks: Frontier HIP/GPU compile and runtime evidence is not part of this sidecar.
MPI-enabled compilation passes, but adaptive-delta-f reductions and particle-aware AMR cost all-reduce still require controlled multi-rank runtime evidence.
Atomic restart publication still requires interrupted-write, truncated-restart, write-failure, timeout, recovery, and Frontier-filesystem qualification.
Repository-wide style debt remains outside this scoped implementation batch.
